auth-core.title: Auth Core
auth-core.pitch: OIDC identity provider + token minting. Every service trusts it.

events-bus.title: Events Bus
events-bus.pitch: The platform event backbone — durable pub/sub the whole fleet emits to.

identity-svc.title: Identity Service
identity-svc.pitch: User profiles, sessions, and org membership on top of Auth Core.

ledger.title: Ledger
ledger.pitch: Append-only double-entry ledger — the money source of truth.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.pitch: Email/SMS/push fan-out driven off the events bus.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.pitch: Streaming rollups + warehouse loads for product metrics.

user-api.title: User API
user-api.pitch: The public BFF the web + mobile clients call.

billing-svc.title: Billing Service
billing-svc.pitch: Subscriptions, invoices, and dunning over the Ledger.

reporting.title: Reporting
reporting.pitch: Finance + ops reports composed from ledger and analytics.

search-svc.title: Search Service
search-svc.pitch: Catalog + user search index, refreshed from the events bus.

admin-console.title: Admin Console
admin-console.pitch: Internal back-office — accounts, billing, and reporting.
